name: Kinesis Silver
oneLiner: KAG is Kinesis Silver, a tokenized claim on one troy ounce of investment-grade silver bullion with direct physical redemption and transaction-fee yield sharing.
collateral: Investment-grade physical silver bullion (1 KAG = 1 troy ounce)
pegMechanism: KMS Labs' ERC-20 KAG is backed 1:1 by Kinesis-native KAG after compliance onboarding; native KAG is then redeemable for allocated physical silver through Kinesis Cayman. ERC-20 balances do not accrue Kinesis transaction-fee yield.

proofOfReserves.provider: Bureau Veritas Commodities UK Ltd (Inspectorate International; commodity vault inspection under agreed procedures with no opinion - the token-vs-metal comparison exists only in the issuer cover letter, whose signatory heads both Kinesis and the vault operator ABX)

latestReport.reviewer: PoR verification sweep 2026-08 (reconciliation set to none: the token-vs-metal comparison appears only in the issuer cover letter, not in Bureau Veritas's findings)

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: KAG is a direct allocated-commodity claim on silver: Kinesis discloses that holders legally own fully allocated bullion outside the Kinesis balance sheet, identifies ABX as custodian, and publishes a recurring Bureau Veritas physical audit program. Migrated to commodity-claim under methodology v9.14; the owner ruling scopes the archetype to all direct commodity claims, silver included.

sources.label: Kinesis trust and security disclosure (legal title, off-balance-sheet allocation, ABX custody)
